trans-unit.source: You decided to train a model with the current configuration. As an effect, all options to edit the configuration have been temporarily removed or disabled to make sure the configuration you see is the same configuration the model uses. If you want to make changes to your configuration, you need to discard the current model first. If you discard your model, you can again perform any changes and train a new model based on the new configuration.

Konfiguratsiyani o‘zgartirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, avval joriy modeldan voz kechishingiz kerak. Modeldan voz kechgach, o‘zgarishlar kiritib, ular asosida yangi modelni o‘qitishingiz mumkin.

Each row needs to represent one set containing the features and the label. Seperate items with a comma (spaces before and after the comma are okay). trans-unit.source: The Pima Indians Diabetes data set involves predicting the onset of diabetes within 5 years in Pima Indians given medical details. It is a binary (2-class) classification problem. The number of observations for each class is not balanced. There are 768 observations with 8 input variables and 1 output variable. Missing values are believed to be encoded with zero values.

Har bir sinfdagi kuzatuvlar soni muvozanatli emas. 768 ta kuzatuv, 8 ta kirish o‘zgaruvchisi va 1 ta chiqish o‘zgaruvchisi bor. Yetishmayotgan qiymatlar nol bilan kodlangan deb hisoblanadi.

trans-unit.source: Why are some important options not editable or completely missing?

trans-unit.source: Many options are uneditable after you started a training to make sure what you see is actually what got translated into the model. To be able to edit everything again, just use the option to reset the model. After you performed your desired changes, you can then train a new model that respects them. If there is no trained model and you are missing options, most likely your teacher has disabled them for you.
trans-unit.target: O‘qitish boshlangandan so‘ng ko‘plab parametrlarni tahrirlab bo‘lmaydi, shunda model siz ko‘rayotgan konfiguratsiyaning aynan o‘zidan foydalanadi. Hammasini yana tahrirlash uchun modelni qayta tiklang. Kerakli o‘zgarishlarni kiritgach, ularga amal qiluvchi yangi modelni o‘qitishingiz mumkin. Agar o‘qitilgan model bo‘lmasa-yu, parametrlar yetishmasa, o‘qituvchingiz ularni o‘chirgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
